result: One injectable SessionClockProvider now supplies receive, availability, ingest, decision and simulated execution times; exchange time is retained from the provider payload. Kite receive is captured after quote response and availability after normalization. The runner filters decision-visible events, persists an aware simulated execution timestamp, rejects backward time, and resumes from the original durable decision time.
focused_tests: 86 passed (forward-session crash, runner, clock, Kite, intraday, session-date, and book integration)
limitations: Default production clock is UTC system time; independent synchronization/attestation is not provided by this software.
